'''Kimp Minmirn''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who aided [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mils Giel]] in developing [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Tirrith]] on [[Beheboth]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Giel and his aide, [[Malka]], decided that the Quarren's usefulness had ended, and killed him.
